yes he is, i didnt wanna spoil it!!

well the t1000 is a endo skeletal machine system with living organic tissue. basically he gets older looking but his nucular battery keeps him going. they addressed this in the last movie genesis

vudu, hulu, redbox, youtube tv, etc

both really you can find it thru vudu and redbox for like 3.99 those are pay to play, but hulu is a service where you pay  monthly amount and stream all you want,.

last year actually

thats really a debate. some people didnt like it, but i think they where not bog fans of the franchise before hand, but fans of the franchise loved it.

glad to help!!! have a great day and enjoy the movie!
